spans.text: Coordinates confirmed. The destination is just ahead.
By accessing Berlin's official map archive with special clearance, the Commander and company easily found the plant that J mentioned.
...This must be it. Stop the vehicle here, we're walking the rest of the way.
9, please stay in the vehicle as our point of contact. Also, keep an eye on M4 and Morridow.
Sure! Leave that to me~ ♪
Ugh... Can't I stay behind as well...?
Don't even think about it. This is where your external battery comes in useful.
There's a "No Entry" sign on the fence.
So are you just gonna pack your bags and go home?
...That's not what I mean.
ST AR-15 walks a few steps forward and cuts down a few bushes and weeds in her way with a knife.
That logo up there doesn't look like Paradeus' logo. Is it a new design that I'm not aware of?
This is the German government's emblem.
What's the surprise? We knew Paradeus had ties with the government all along.
Yeah, but all the facilities we've attacked before belonged to either Paradeus or Galatea.
Seeing a building that's clearly advertising its connections with the government... This is a first.
Who cares?! We just have to kill all the Paradeus that we run into, right?!
...This IS strange, but on the flip side, it also means that we've found Paradeus's actual seat of power this time.
45, any news from J?
Not a peep, unfortunately.
...Should we wait for him before we move?
Honestly, even though he did say this is a key location, we don't actually know what's in there.
...I don't know what's in there either, but someone seems to be pretty impatient.
Hm?
The Commander's brow furrows. An indistinct noise drifts into earshot.
...Is that coming from inside the plant?
The Commander looks up. Sounds of destruction come from inside the dark and seemingly empty building.
Someone's in there!
They're wrecking the facility!
Commander!
We can't afford to wait for him! We're going in now! Hurry!
...What a barren piece of land.
This just goes to show what's so special about this base. I was quite surprised when I first found this place as well.
A metal fence... We don't have permission to enter the premises, do we?
J, is the fence ahead cut open?
You're right. There's quite a large opening.
Oh, that was my doing. I created the opening when I first came and scouted out the place.
I see... So you've been here before?
Just to take a quick look around outside the plant. Since I was operating alone, it would be difficult to escape if I got spotted by the people inside.
That's true. In that case, let's make this quick and go in right away.
Hold on.
Aren't you going to wait for the Commander?
They've probably gone in already. I'm seeing some tracks here.
But the plant is quiet as a tomb... More importantly... Agent J, are you sure these are the coordinates?
I don't have clearance to access the map archive, but this doesn't feel right... Maybe we should double-check just to be sure?
What exactly do you mean?
...I think we shouldn't charge in recklessly.
Are you done yet?
If you're worried, I can go on ahead and check out the place while you stay here.
No, no need for that. We'll go in together.
Agent J!
Jacques, bring someone to scout out the east and check the surroundings.
You've brought a detonator, right? Rig the explosives along the perimeter 50 meters away. That will stop any pursuers when we withdraw.
Understood!
Bauer, come here.
I need you to set up a temporary radio station here.
We have no idea what's going on in there; normal comms could be intercepted and monitored.
Check with the others. We need a restricted and encrypted comm link.
Roger!
Once we're in, maintain 3-4-3 formation and watch each other's blind spots.
I know you're all itching to take down some big fish, but their firepower could be ten times more superior.
Besides, we're about to enter their territory. If we start exchanging fire, I need a route of retreat immediately.
We'll be using the same code system and p2p comms.
Etch the mission objective into your brains—find the rescue target, Angelia.
Yes, sir!
...Happy?
Mona has no more reason to object to the mission. She nods.
Then please lead the way, Miss RPK-16.
This way.
